summary: TOOL-4 Filter products by category and brand
description:
As a customer, I want to filter so I can narrow down the catalogue.

* Selecting one category → only products from that category appear.
* Selecting two categories → products from both appear.
* Combining a category and a brand → only products matching both appear.
* Unchecking all filters → the full list returns.

criteria.text: Selecting one category → only products from that category appear.
Selecting two categories → products from both appear.
Combining a category and a brand → only products matching both appear.
Unchecking all filters → the full list returns.

cases.title: Selecting one category shows only that category's products
cases.preconditions: Catalogue page open with no filters selected; <a category that contains at least one product, and at least one product outside that category exists>.
steps: Note the products listed with no filters applied.
cases.expected: Only products from <category A> appear; products from other categories are no longer listed.

cases.title: Selecting two categories shows products from both
cases.preconditions: Catalogue page open with no filters selected; <two categories that each contain at least one product>.
cases.expected: Products from both <category A> and <category B> appear.

cases.title: Combining a category and a brand shows only products matching both
cases.preconditions: Catalogue page open with no filters selected; <a category and a brand that share at least one product>; <at least one product in that category from a different brand> and <at least one product of that brand in a different category> also exist.
cases.expected: Only products that are in <category A> and of <brand X> appear; the <category A> product from another brand and the <brand X> product from another category are not listed.

cases.title: Unchecking all filters returns the full list
cases.preconditions: Catalogue page open; <a category> and <a brand> available as filters; the full unfiltered product list has been noted.
steps: Note the full product list with no filters applied.
Select the category <category A> and the brand <brand X>.
Uncheck the category <category A> and the brand <brand X> so no filters remain selected.
cases.expected: The full product list returns, matching the list noted in step 1.

cases.title: Category and brand combination with no matching product
cases.preconditions: Catalogue page open with no filters selected; <a category and a brand that have no product in common, where each has products of its own>.
steps: Select the brand <brand Y> (no product of <brand Y> is in <category A>).
cases.expected: Only products matching both filters appear, so no products are listed. The exact empty-result message or screen is not specified in the story.
